'''KyLessia''' was located within the [[KyLessia system/Legends|KyLessia system]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[wulfruit tree]]s, [[KyLessian fruit bat]]s, and [[KyLessian feather mite]]s.<ref name="The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> Its exports included [[KyLessian Fruit Distillate]], a popular [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>
